about: mdhtml's mutants (wf10 corpus wave 1, PA3): each law's mutant, killed by `ergo test` of its package, and the edits no law or case sees, which TestMdhtmlAgreesWithControl in cmd/ergo (the CommonMark 0.31.2 examples, spliced documents and the workload, against the hand Go control) kills.

mutants.name: mdhtml-escape-keeps-lt
mutants.rule: Escaped text starts no tag (law html.EscapeHasNoMarkup).

mutants.name: mdhtml-unescape-keeps-amp
mutants.rule: Unescape reads back what Escape wrote (law html.EscapeRoundTrip).

mutants.name: mdhtml-href-lets-javascript-through
mutants.rule: A safe Url never names javascript: (law html.HrefIsSafe).

mutants.name: mdhtml-escapable-skips-the-first-range
mutants.rule: Every ASCII punctuation character can be escaped (law markdown.EscapedPunctuationIsText).

mutants.name: mdhtml-code-span-strips-one-side
mutants.rule: A code span loses one space at each end only when it has both (law markdown.CodeSpanKeepsText).

mutants.name: mdhtml-emphasis-never-strong
mutants.from: let use = if c.num >= 2 && q.delims[opener].num >= 2 { 2 } else { 1 }
mutants.rule: Two delimiters make strong emphasis (law markdown.EmphasisNests).

mutants.name: mdhtml-list-items-never-loosen
mutants.rule: Items apart by a blank line make a loose list (law markdown.TightListsHaveNoParagraphs).

mutants.name: mdhtml-labels-do-not-fold
mutants.rule: A label matches in any case (law markdown.DefinitionsAnywhere).

mutants.name: mdhtml-bad-reference-is-its-number
mutants.rule: A numeric reference past U+10FFFF or of a surrogate is U+FFFD (law markdown.EntitiesAreTheirText).

mutants.name: mdhtml-keywords-drop-a-space
mutants.rule: The go keywords highlighter keeps the code's text (law markdown.KeywordsMarkEachKeyword).

mutants.name: mdhtml-keyword-class
mutants.rule: A Go keyword in a go block is one <span class="kw"> (law markdown.KeywordsMarkEachKeyword).

mutants.name: mdhtml-tag-block-keeps-the-blank
mutants.rule: A blank line ends a TagBlock or a LoneTag before it (law HtmlBlock.TagsEndAtABlankLine).

mutants.name: mdhtml-marker-ends-before
mutants.rule: The line with the end marker is the block's (law HtmlBlock.MarkersEndWithTheLine).

mutants.name: mdhtml-tag-block-ends-at-any-line
mutants.rule: A line with no > ends no HTML block (law HtmlBlock.NoMarkerStays).

mutants.name: mdhtml-workload-has-no-quote
mutants.rule: The workload reaches every block (law workload.DocumentHasEveryBlock).

mutants.name: mdhtml-sharp-s-does-not-fold
mutants.rule: Label folding is Unicode case folding: ẞ matches SS (spec example 540).

mutants.name: mdhtml-no-rule-of-three
mutants.rule: A run that can open and close does not match one whose lengths sum to a multiple of 3 (rule 9; spec examples 411 and on).

mutants.name: mdhtml-symbols-are-not-punctuation
mutants.rule: A Unicode symbol counts as punctuation for flanking (0.31; spec example 354).

mutants.name: mdhtml-loose-block-in-an-item-is-tight
mutants.rule: Two blocks of one item apart by a blank line make the list loose (spec example 312).

mutants.name: mdhtml-null-reference-is-null
mutants.rule: � is U+FFFD (spec example 26).

mutants.name: mdhtml-safe-mode-keeps-data-text
mutants.rule: A safe Url is no data: link other than an image (law html.HrefIsSafe).
